name: claude-code-booster
description: Curated plugins and skills to boost Claude Code productivity — skill discovery, security testing, and more

plugins.name: skill-finder
plugins.description: Search and discover agent skills from skills.sh and skillfish registries. Interactive selection and one-click install.

plugins.name: linter
plugins.description: Auto-formats files after every edit using the right linter for each language.

plugins.name: penetration-tester
plugins.description: Automated penetration testing for web applications. Identifies OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities and suggests remediation.

plugins.name: reverse-engineer
plugins.description: General-purpose reverse engineering toolkit. Decompiles, disassembles, and maps binaries, scripts, and applications across all languages.

plugins.name: codex-image-gen
plugins.description: Generate and edit images using Codex CLI's built-in imagegen skill. Natural-language prompts for creation and editing.

plugins.name: frontend-roadmap
plugins.description: Guided frontend project preparation — collects requirements, references, design platform output, and tech stack choices into a comprehensive roadmap.md plan.
